items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: one night we played, uh, we played in Edgar, uh, on the river road. Yeah. And, uh, guitar slam was playing, and, uh, he went out, out of the dance hall

ctx.x: They tell me he used to be a block away sometime playing the guitar.

Yeah, and he had a, he had a long chord on his guitar. And, uh, one night, one night we played, uh, we played in Edgar, uh, on the river road. Yeah. And, uh, guitar slam was playing, and, uh, he went out, out of the dance hall, and got under a car, playing, with guitar. And we had to come get him. He got stuck and couldn't get out. He was under the car.
He got under, I don't know how in the world he did it.
